description: This file defines the SubmissionRepository interface, which extends JpaRepository to manage Submission entities and provides custom query methods for retrieving submissions by assignment and student IDs.

classes.name: SubmissionRepository
classes.description: A Spring Data JPA repository interface for managing Submission entities with custom finder methods.

methods.name: findByAssignmentIdAndStudentId
methods.description: Retrieves an Optional containing a Submission matching the given assignment and student IDs.

methods.name: findByAssignmentId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Submissions associated with the given assignment ID.
